about: Conquer the Underdark, Become Shogun Nioh 3 is the highly anticipated sequel to the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh. A deadly struggle unfolds amidst the devastation of an alternate Warring States period, where criminals run rampant and yokai lurk everywhere. Key Game Elements: • An open world that challenges you to the max This game features an open world full of the characteristic tension of the “Nioh” series, while allowing you to explore at will. In this dark world of samurai, you will encounter formidable yokai, explore menacing villages where darkness lurks, and fight against the sinister presence of the “Underdark”. • Samurai and Ninja Combat Styles During combat, you can seamlessly and instantly switch between two combat styles. You can face your enemies head-on with the Samurai Style, or use the quick movements and Ninjutsu techniques of the Ninja Style.
